newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bourse to remain open despite APEC meet.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bourse to remain open despite APEC meet.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday it will remain open on November 22 and 25 even though the foreign exchange market is closed for the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting.

"The world markets are open and active on these days. They will be watching us closely in relation to the developments of the APEC Summit being held concurrently," PSE president Vitaliano Nanagas II said in a statement.
Earlier, the Bankers Association of the Philippines said there will be no trading in the peso-dollar market in view of the APEC meeting.
Bankers, however, said money market operations and trading in cross currencies like dollar, yen and mark would remain open during those days.
Philippine President Fidel Ramos declared these days national holidays for Manila and the Subic areas, with the exception of certain industries including banks.
